description: Regression baseline for the converged steel ESIM Karl iteration in calc_fem_coilmesh.py on the regenerated Kelvin skin mesh.

sample.note: Gapped torus A-V coil, workpiece SIBC and Kelvin exterior. Cubit-regenerated mesh with 246108 elements.

notes: The June ESIM depth mesh under-resolved the steel skin depth. The current depth solver was checked against the constant-permeability analytic impedance.
Coil loss is the volumetric Joule loss. The coil mesh remains coarse relative to the copper skin depth. This baseline covers the specified discrete model.
The steel B-H curve drives the nonlinear surface impedance. The workpiece uses a surface condition, with mu_r=1.0 as the volume seed.
